$comment: Era 02, opened 21 September 2026. NO STAKE. No bank, no P/L, no running balance -- staking is suspended under methodology.md section 14 and this ledger deliberately has nowhere to record a wager. The scoreboard is closing line value (section 15): measured against the margin-removed closing price, CLV IS the edge expressed as expected value, not a proxy for it. Reference venue is a betting exchange (section 16). Competition is the Premier League (section 17). Every closing price must be DERIVED -- from data/E0_<season>.csv or a timestamped capture -- never typed by hand. Three numbers in Era 01 were typed rather than derived and all three were wrong in the flattering direction. A null closing_price is honest; an invented one is not. Decision point: after 60 selections across all books, if median CLV is at or below zero the project stops looking for edge in football betting.
